the_day_unfolds.light: Warm golden morning: pollen, rose-quartz softness, bright pier water, and the safety of home before the unknown opens.
Gold drains into cold blue-grey as wind rises, the map is lost, and the distant sea becomes unreadable.
Storm-dark cove cut by communal crystal colour, a beacon reaching before the rescue is complete.
Darkest storm-blue underwater, with the aquamarine glow coming from Keen’s vacant cuffs before any crystal is awarded.
Storm breaks into cool clearing light, then warm late-afternoon sun around the earned Aquamarine crystal.
Golden-hour calm, warmer than the beginning, with wet storm traces still visible so the ache remains.
